drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our initial revisions for discussion, subject to client approval. The settlement amount remains open; please provide your client's proposed payment amount and timing. We have clarified that the release follows receipt of payment and added customary confidentiality exceptions. No binding settlement will arise until the parties execute a final agreement.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) in immediately available funds by [PAYMENT DEADLINE TO BE AGREED]. The amount and payment deadline remain subject to express agreement by the parties in the executed final agreement.
edits.name: Payment terms

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the dispute described in the Recitals. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it.
edits.name: Release upon payment

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except for disclosures required by law, regulation, or court order; disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement; and disclosures to legal, tax, and financial advisers who are bound by confidentiality obligations. Where legally permitted, a party required to disclose shall provide prompt notice to the other party and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment.
edits.name: Confidentiality exceptions

drafter.private_reasoning: No authority has been provided to accept the proposed payment amount or deadline. Keep both open pending express client approval, preserve cleared-funds protection, and add the requested fees-and-costs allocation. drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. We have added an express provision that each party bears its own fees and costs and clarified that the release and dismissal with prejudice follow receipt of the full settlement payment in cleared funds. The confidentiality language is retained. Your proposed USD 10,000 payment and 30-day deadline remain subject to our client’s review and are not accepted; the draft therefore retains placeholders for those terms. All terms remain subject to client approval and execution of a final agreement.

edits.text: 2. RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. Only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the dispute described in the Recitals. Promptly after such receipt, Plaintiff shall file the documents necessary to dismiss with prejudice the claims asserted against Defendant in the action arising out of that dispute. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it.
edits.name: Release and dismissal conditioned on payment

edits.text:
4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.

5. FEES AND COSTS. Each party shall bear its own attorneys' fees and costs incurred in connection with the dispute and the negotiation and execution of this Agreement.

6. SUBJECT TO EXECUTION. No settlement shall be binding unless and until a final agreement is approved and executed by both parties.
edits.name: Fees and costs; execution requirement
